questions.q: What is the maximum number of live emails allowed to be sent in this milestone?
Who is the permitted recipient of the live email?
questions.a: Only the Boss email address registered in the runtime parameters (Boss allowlist).

questions.q: Are customer email addresses allowed as recipients?
questions.a: No. Any customer-like email address triggers an immediate hard block and execution failure.

questions.q: Are real provider credentials allowed to be committed to the repository or .env files?
questions.a: No. They must be injected dynamically via runtime environment variables.

questions.q: How is the live sending action authorized?
questions.a: By providing the manual token OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN=pilot_email_action_001 at runtime.

questions.q: What happens if the same token or idempotency key is submitted more than once?
questions.a: The duplicate send protection blocks execution immediately to prevent double sending.

questions.q: What is the retry policy for live test sending?
questions.a: Strictly DISABLED. If the send fails, the operator must review the logs and request a new token if needed.

questions.q: What is verified immediately before calling the email provider API?
questions.a: The preflight kill switch status. If active, execution is terminated immediately.

questions.q: Is any sensitive token, secret, or raw email address allowed in the committed audit files?
questions.a: No. All secrets, tokens, and email addresses must be fully redacted before saving to disk.

questions.q: What is the default execution mode if the --execute-live flag is omitted?
questions.a: Dry-run mode, which performs all checks but does not produce any external effect.
